enrichment.core_claim: A demixing measure shows cortex is recurrence-driven with commitment attractors while transformers are input-driven, making the unfolding argument empirically decidable.
enrichment.ask_question: Would recurrent language models or state space models show the commitment attractor signature seen in rat cortex?
enrichment.challenge_question: Since decision commitment is not conscious access, why should this dynamical difference bear on which systems are conscious?
